description: This file defines the ReactAgentController class, a Flutter ChangeNotifier that manages the UI logic and state for the ReAct Agent feature, including API key management, agent execution, and step visualization.

classes.name: ReactAgentController
classes.description: A controller class for managing the state and behavior of the ReAct Agent screen in Flutter. It handles API key storage, agent execution, and step state updates, extending ChangeNotifier to notify UI components of changes.

methods.name: loadStoredApiKeyAndConfigure
methods.description: Loads the stored OpenAI API key from secure storage and updates the agent service mode accordingly.

methods.name: saveApiKey
methods.description: Saves the provided API key to secure storage, updates the agent service, and indicates whether live mode is enabled.

methods.name: clearApiKey
methods.description: Clears the stored API key from secure storage and switches the agent service to mock mode.

methods.name: startAgent
methods.description: Initiates the agent run with the current user input, handling validation and updating error state.

methods.name: clearSteps
methods.description: Resets the agent steps and related UI state.

methods.name: setUserInput
methods.description: Updates the user input string and notifies listeners.

methods.name: getStepIcon
methods.description: Returns the appropriate icon for a given step type.

methods.name: getStepColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with a given step type.

methods.name: getStepTitle
methods.description: Returns the display title for a given step type.
